facts.text: The resort has direct beach access.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy spacious rooms with private balconies, stunning sea views, marble bathrooms, and direct beach access

facts.text: Rooms have private balconies and marble bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy spacious rooms with private balconies, stunning sea views, marble bathrooms, and direct beach access

facts.text: Rooms combine contemporary design with a touch of Berber heritage.
facts.excerpt: Deluxe King size bed Ocean view room with contemporary room design and a touch of Berber heritage

facts.text: The resort's villas each have a private garden and a heated infinity pool.
facts.excerpt: fully equipped kitchen, private garden and heated infinity pool, along with butler services

facts.text: The villas come with butler services.
facts.excerpt: fully equipped kitchen, private garden and heated infinity pool, along with butler services

facts.text: Morimoto Taghazout Bay is a restaurant at the resort that serves sushi platters and dishes such as beef tataki.
facts.excerpt: Kaleidoscopic sushi platters and dishes like beef tataki with lemon-soy vinaigrette and lobster sushi-rice risotto win raves at Morimoto Taghazout Bay

facts.text: Beef and Reef is a surf-and-turf restaurant beside the resort's palm-lined infinity pool.
facts.excerpt: Beef and Reef, the refined surf-and-turf eatery beside the palm-lined infinity pool

facts.text: Nola is a speakeasy-style bar at the resort with a whiskey collection and Cuban cigars.
facts.excerpt: for the world-class whiskey collection and fine Cuban cigars

facts.text: The spa facilities include a sauna, jacuzzi, hammam and magnesium pool.
facts.excerpt: Unlimited access to fitness center and SPA facilities (sauna, jacuzzi, hammam and magnesium pool)

facts.text: The resort has a Fun4Kidz Club and a playground for younger guests, and a teen space called Le Hangout.
facts.excerpt: At Le Hangout, teens can play pool, basketball, and soccer, or catch a movie in the mini-theater, while the Fun4Kidz Club and an impressive playground keeps younger guests entertained.

facts.text: The resort heats its pool with a solar-powered system and recycles greywater for property irrigation.
facts.excerpt: a solar-powered pool-heating system, and greywater recycling for property irrigation

facts.text: Taghazout town center is a 30-minute walk from the resort along the beachfront promenade.
facts.excerpt: a pleasant 30-minute stroll away along the beachfront promenade

facts.text: The resort sits on the Atlantic coast ten miles north of Agadir.
The resort offers surfing classes, golf, a spa and cultural excursions.
facts.excerpt: Fairmont Taghazout Bay offers stunning ocean views, surfing classes, golf, a luxurious spa, fine dining, cultural excursions, and endless outdoor adventures

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler describes it as the first luxury resort to debut in the former fishing village of Taghazout.
facts.excerpt: The first luxury resort to debut in the windswept former fishing village of Taghazout
